name: application-request-builder
title: Request Builder
description: An API client request bar (method, URL, Send) paired with Params/Headers/Body/Auth tabs, shown with editable key-value header rows.
useWhen: Building a developer-facing API client or API testing tool where users construct and send HTTP requests.
The request needs structured Params/Headers/Body/Auth sections rather than a single free-text request definition.
avoidWhen: You're building a structured filter/condition builder rather than an HTTP request — use `Query Builder` for that instead.
You only need to display a fixed API call, not let users edit it — a code block from `terminal-blocks` is simpler for read-only examples.
responsiveBehavior: The method selector, URL field, and Send button share one row via flex, with the URL field absorbing available width; on narrow viewports, wrap Send below the URL rather than shrinking the URL field below a usable width.
accessibility: The method select has a visually hidden label (sr-only) associating it with 'HTTP method' for screen readers.
Each header row's remove button carries an aria-label ("Remove header") since only an icon is shown.
The active tab (Headers) is marked with both a bottom border and aria-current="true", not color alone.

variants.title: Headers tab
variants.description: A POST request bar (method select, URL, Send button) with Params/Headers/Body/Auth tabs, Headers active, showing two editable key-value header rows and an 'Add header' affordance.
accessibility: The method select has an associated (visually hidden) label; each remove button carries an aria-label.

variants.title: Headers tab (Dark)
variants.description: Request builder adapted for dark surfaces, including the method-select highlight and header-row backgrounds.
accessibility: URL bar, tabs, and header-row text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
